verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs say appending `.md` to any page's URL returns a Markdown version, and describe the output as clean Markdown for AI tools and LLM integrations. Content fetched from `.md` URLs such as use-cases/api-reference.md and switch.md corroborates this in practice. A probe of the docs root `/docs.md` returned 404, but that path is a section root rather than a clear page, so it does not concretely contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation on customer-hosted page URLs, an explanation of the `/docs.md` root 404, and detail on how clean the Markdown output is (e.g. how components are rendered).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every published page serves clean markdown at its URL (e.g. appending .md) so agents skip the HTML

citations.quote: Add `.md` to any page's URL to view a Markdown version.
Export clean Markdown versions of your documentation pages for AI tools, LLM integrations, and automated content processing workflows.
